title: Per-deck route coverage (Gate 3; v2 adds the v3.3 deck-level layer)
description: Layer 1 (v3.2): every produces-feature of the deck's included combos classified against the WIN-ROUTES rules. Layer 2 (v3.3, the `deck` section): which win routes are actually expressible for THIS deck — direct routes from LETHAL/WIN_TRIGGER features plus conversion routes gated on payoff support from the 99 — with WIN-ROUTES §3 guards. status=blocked means no route is expressible: batch results would understate the deck, and DossierCheck refuses it.

source.description: Present when the classification came from an APPROVED route-library entry rather than the versioned rules (PR-13; optional additive widening of v2).

direct_win.description: true when any feature is LETHAL or WIN_TRIGGER; false = resources only, payoff conversion required (the LethalityPlanner's job).

payoffs.description: WIN-ROUTES §2b payoff class -> card names found in the 99 (plus the commander_creature pseudo-class). Only non-empty classes appear.

origin.description: direct = a LETHAL/WIN_TRIGGER feature names it (combo is the payoff); conversion = reached from a RESOURCE feature class via 99-payoff support.

support.description: intrinsic = no 99 support needed; supported = every requirement group has a full-strength payoff; partial = weaker alternates only (route usable with hazards); unsupported = not expressible via this deck's 99.

enablers.description: Payoff/enabler cards from the 99 this route relies on — TutorWeights input.

missing.description: Payoff classes that would upgrade support — deckbuilding advice.

win_paths.description: Routes with support better than unsupported. 0 with included combos present = blocked.
